name: template-media
body: Project media: fonts, logos, images, video and any other file type under the resolved library's `themes/<name>/` or `media/` are served by `kalide start` from the resolved library root (offline, 127.0.0.1 only) with a content type derived from the file extension; every media file type is served (there is no allow-list of media types). Reference rules: layouts reference shared media via `{{media "path"}}`, the path being relative to the resolved library's `media/` only and staying within it (requirements.constraint.media-paths-library-relative); theme files are served from their theme directory and may be referenced from any theme CSS — and every CSS it imports — by a relative path from its own location or by the reserved `theme:<name>/` prefix; a theme's CSS (and any CSS it imports, wherever that CSS lives) may additionally reference the library's shared `media/` tree with the reserved `media:` URL prefix, validated the same way and rewritten to the served media URL (theme-media-references) — the layout helper `media` resolves only within the library's `media/` tree, while theme CSS reaches `media/` and other themes through the two reserved prefixes. AC: a `.woff2`, an `.svg` and an `.mp4` placed under the resolved library's `media/` and referenced from a layout via `media` are served and resolve in the rendered deck; a `.woff2` in the library's `themes/<name>/fonts/` referenced by relative `url()` from that theme's CSS is served and resolves; a `.woff2` under the library's `media/` referenced from a theme's CSS via the reserved `media:` prefix is served and resolves; a `.woff2` in another theme referenced from a theme's CSS via `url('theme:<name>/fonts/x.woff2')` is served and resolves; `@import url('media:css/x.css')` in a theme's CSS is served and resolves.
